concept.title: The layout
concept.shortdesc: The view has three resizable columns (drag the dividers to resize; widths are remembered):

ul.li: Left — the artifact list/tree with search and filters.
Center — the selected artifact: header, body, links, attachments.
Right — the Chatter panel: comments on the selected artifact.

conbody.p: The ? button beside the notification bell opens a quick-reference help sidebar with artifact and link type definitions.
